notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250925 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Rivals! We're thrilled to announce the upcoming patch drops on [u][b]September 25th, 2025, at 09: 00 :00 (UTC)[/b][/u]! This update will be deployed seamlessly, with no server downtime required! Simply log in after the update and jump right back into the action. Here's what's coming in this patch:[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]Maps and Modes[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Explore the mystical City of the Immortals in our new Convergence map:[b][u] K'un-Lun: Heart of Heaven.[/u][/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]New Event: Shou-Lao's Blessing[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]The long silence has ended, the Immortal Dragon Shou-Lao has awakened! His glory and blessings await every brave warrior! [/p][p align="justify"][b]Complete Shou-Lao's Blessing for a FREE Costume Coin, 500 Units, and 500 Unstable Molecules![/b][/p][p][b][u]Event Period: September 25th, 2025, 09: 00 :00 to October 9th, 2025, 09: 00 :00[/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948917/6c1d62e0b58150ffad34d20023ab5170afc88423.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New In Store[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]1. Hela - The Grim Lady Bundle
2. Hela - The Grim Lady Emoji Bundle
3. New Ultimate Ability VFX:
      a. Invisible Woman - Azure Shade
      b. Mantis - Oceanic Harmony
      c. The Punisher - Aqua Arsenal[/p][p][u][b]Available from: September 26th, 2025, at 02: 00 :00(UTC)[/b][/u][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Accessories[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]Added new Accessories for Magneto, Scarlet Witch, Luna Snow, and Cloak & Dagger. They'll be available to exchange in the Store after the update.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]New Additions and Optimizations[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]1.  Accessory Points can now also be earned in Arcade matches. The amount varies by mode.
2. In-game Tournament Livestreams Hub: Watch the Marvel Rivals Ignite Stage 2 matches live from the new in-game Livestreams under the Tournament tab!
3. Resource Rumble Updates:
     a. Faster match pace, with more focus on the first two available areas:
           i. Reduce resources in each Available Area from 210 to 200.
           ii. Increase Rumble Phase Breakpoint from 60 to 100.
           iii. Reduce Extraction Phase resource target for victory from 360 to 300.
           iv. Reduce Rumble Phase resource target for victory from 300 to 200. 
           v. Rumble Phase Rumble Speed-Ups have been adjusted to fit new values.
      b. Spawn room speed-ups and jump pads at points A & C have been adjusted for heroes without mobility abilities to quickly get back into the action.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/h2][p align="justify"]With Marvel Rivals Ignite Stage 2 kicking off in major regions, tournament Twitch Drops are here! Simply accumulate the required viewing time to claim your rewards.
This round's drops include the Rocket Raccoon - Will of Galacta costume along with related bundle content.[/p][p][u][b]Drops Period: September 25th, 2025, at 14: 00 :00 (UTC) to October 23rd, 2025, at 09: 00 :00[/b][/u][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]All Platforms[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. We've iced an issue with Human Torch's 'Hot & Trending' Achievement that could cause it to fail in rare cases.  
2. Fixed a bug where the Battle Pass bonus was playing invisibility cloak at the results screen, but we've revealed it for good!  
3. Squashed a bug where the player name anonymity effect in the top-left voice prompt stubbornly stuck around like Loki's tricks, even after the time limit expired.  
4. Stopped a dizzying spectator situation where switching to follow-cam and rotating your view with a controller, followed by using keyboard shortcuts, may cause directional inputs to twist like Doctor Strange's portals!  [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. Mister Fantastic's Stretching the Limits: Fixed an issue where Reed's Stretch Punch could occasionally fail to deal damage when sweeping through targets. No more missed punches, Reed's reach is as fantastic as ever!  
2. Mister Fantastic's Rubber Rebound: Resolved an issue where the projectile after absorbing damage with Reflexive Rubber sometimes didn't deal damage. Now, Reed's payback is truly fantastic!  
3. Peni Parker's Spider-Sync: Addressed a bug where, during her Ultimate Ability, the sound effect for deploying Spider-Drones didn't match the actual spawn rate while moving. Now Peni and SP//dr are perfectly in sync, no more off-beat spider drops!  
4. Luna Snow's Frosty Footwork Fix: Some of Luna's costumes had her sliding slightly off-center during her Ultimate Ability dance. Now, her performance stays perfectly centered on stage, no more straying too far from the spotlight![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates on the horizon. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250918 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Rivals![/p][p]We're thrilled to announce the upcoming patch drops on September 18th, 2025, at 09: 00: 00 (UTC)! This update will be deployed seamlessly, with no server downtime required! Simply log in after the update and jump right back into the action.
Here's what's coming in this patch:[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]New Event: SUMMER SPECIAL VOL.2[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The highly anticipated Summer Special Vol. 2 is about to heat things up! Level up the event to unlock FREE rewards like The Thing - Rocky Tide![/p][p]Upgrade to the Premium Edition for permanent access and unlock even more exclusive rewards, such as Mantis - Oceanic Harmony and Human Torch - Sunny Sizzler costumes.[/p][p]Limited-Time Event: September 18th, 2025, at 9：00：00 (UTC) to October 17th, 2025, at 9: 00: 00.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948917/2a86f5230ac6066751dd94496371a4b3de336f3c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p]1. Free Limited-Time Bundle: Receive the "Volleyball Bash" group emote combo bundle for FREE![/p][p]Claim Period: September 19th, 2025, 02: 00: 00 to September 22nd, 2025, 02: 00: 00 (UTC) Don't drop the ball and miss this one![/p][p]2. Invisible Woman - Azure Shade Bundle[/p][p]3. The Punisher - Aqua Arsenal Bundle[/p][p]Available from: September 19th, 2025, at 02: 00: 00 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]All-New Content[/b][/h3][p]1. Chat Channels now support font color, special characters, emojis, and more. Express yourself like never before![/p][p]2. Replay Data now features more detailed hero statistics.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]All Platforms[/b][/h3][p]1. Quick Match and Arcade games near completion will no longer add Substitute players.[/p][p]2. Fixed abnormal hero data display on other players' Career - Statistics page.  [/p][p]3. Fixed certain battle Stat Highlights not being settable in the Career system.  [/p][p]4. We've removed the Squad text chat channel when solo queueing.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Maps and Modes[/b][/h3][p]1. Reduced Angela's excessively oversized head in Giant-Size Brain Blast.  [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][p]1. Loki's Mischievous Metamorphosis: Fixed a bug where, if Loki used his Ultimate Ability to transform into a costumed Adam Warlock and was KO'd and revived via Regenerative Cocoon, he'd come back wearing Adam's default costume. No more wardrobe malfunctions in the Multiverse!  [/p][p]2. Ultron's Palm Pilot Precision: Tweaked the starting points for Ultron's Encephalo-Ray and Nano-Ray attacks so they now fire perfectly from his palm. Less off-align blasts, more robotic perfection![/p][p]3. Luna Snow's Dance Upgrade: Polished the animation for Luna Snow's Ultimate Ability. Her moves are now smooth enough to impress even Star-Lord at a Guardians dance-off. Luna's Cool Summer Costume will be fixed next patch to nail the perfect dance dancing on the center of her Jellyfish.[/p]

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Season 4: Heart of the Dragon is Now Live
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Rivals![/p][p align="justify"]Season 4 is upon us, and Angela joins the fray in the Heart of Heaven![/p][p align="justify"]The update begins on [b][u]September 12th, 2025, at 09: 00: 00(UTC)[/u][/b], with estimated maintenance lasting 2–3 hours.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]All-New Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]New Hero[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][b]Angela descends to Marvel Rivals. Prepare to unleash Asgardian might![/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New Stories[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. New Serial - Heart of the Dragon
2. New Angela Lore - Her Sister's Keeper
3. New Iron Fist Lore - One True Champion
4. New Loki Lore - Destined For Doom[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]S4 Battle Pass[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Unlock a heavenly new Battle Pass featuring 10 all-new sets of heroic costumes! This season's theme is the mysterious Fruit of Immortality. We hope you enjoy it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948917/93d0c77d23eb9e228e2cf59d8007dc5827140c18.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Season Event[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]The Scroll of the Immortal Beasts has been revealed. Light up the Immortal Beast badges to earn a free costume: Ultron - Wasteland Robot![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948917/8f031cd3977f805a9e97dfea29d7dd1f19cb61e9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Competitive[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Rank Reset: Based on your final Season 3.5 rank, ranks will be demoted by 7 divisions. For example, if you ended the season at Diamond I, your Season 4 journey begins at Gold II.[/p][p align="justify"]New Rank Settlement Rewards: Reach Gold for the divine Angela - Siriana's Silver costume. Earn all-new Nameplate Frames at Diamond and Platinum, plus rock fresh Crests of Honor for Grandmaster, Celestial, Eternity, and the illustrious Top 500.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Arcade Mode Hub[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]Arcade mode has leveled up![/p][p][b]Now with more choices available:[/b][/p][p align="justify"][b]1.  New - Conquest (Annihilation)[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Score 1 point per enemy defeated; first to 50 points wins.
- Map: Tokyo 2099: Ninomaru
 [/p][p align="justify"][b]2. New - Free Fight[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Based on Quick Match (Domination,  Convergence, Convoy) rules, but no restrictions on duplicate heroes; each team can ban 2 heroes (same ban rules as Competitive).
- Map Pool: Same as Quick Match (except Throne of Knull). Upon matchmaking, a map is randomly selected.
 [/p][p align="justify"][b]3. Returning - Clone Rumble[/b][/p][p align="justify"]-  Gameplay experience has been streamlined: Choose from 2 heroes randomly selected by the system. The side that reaches 100% capture progress on the current map wins. (Victory is decided on a single map.)
- Map Pool: Same as Quick Match (Domination). Upon matchmaking, one of 15 small maps is randomly selected.
 [/p][p align="justify"][b]4. Returning: Giant-Size Brain Blast[/b][/p][p align="justify"]-  Same rules as before.
- Map: Tokyo 2099: Ninomaru
 [/p][p align="justify"][b]5. Current: Conquest[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- As per current Conquest rules
- Map: Tokyo 2099: Ninomaru
 [/p][p align="justify"][b]6. Existing: Doom Match[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- As per current Doom Match rules
- Map: Empire of Eternal Night: Sanctum Sanctorum
*All of the above modes are now permanent![/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Arcade Matchmaking[/b][/p][p align="justify"]1. Pick 1–6 modes to queue for.
2. Team up with any number of friends.
 [/p][p align="justify"][b]Other:[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Can gain Hero Proficiency in Arcade, but has daily caps.
 [/p][h3][b]New Systems[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. Emoji Wheel Rework: Added a new list format to equip more emojis, and you can now send them in more scenarios!
2. Costume Rotation: Randomize your hero's look from multiple selected unlocked costumes.
3. Custom Ability VFX Visibility: Choose to see (or hide) others' custom Ultimate Ability effects.
4. Friend Suggestions: Based on your battle performance and preferred heroes, we'll suggest suitable friends to help you connect with more players and team up with compatible allies in-game.
5. Slow Walk: Added slow walk to PC version.
6. Squad Voice Chat: Choose to keep squad comms private by just enabling squad voice chat (the stack you match with) or your entire team (the players you get matched with).
7. Gallery Cards: You can now download high-resolution versions of your Gallery Cards locally on PC and PlayStation? 5.
8. Team Lobby: Entrance animations can now be played in the team lobby.
9. Disconnect Pause: In Custom Game - Tournament Room, hosts can enable auto-pause if a player disconnects.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. Angela - Skuld 2099 Bundle[/p][p align="justify"]2. Angela - Emoji Bundle[/p][p]3. Angela - Cerulean Lightbringer Costume
[/p][p][b]Available from: September 12th, 2025, at 9: 00: 00 (UTC)[/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/h3][p]\[p align="justify"]As Season 4.0 kicks off, get ready for a new round of Twitch Drops. Simply accumulate the required viewing time to claim your rewards. This round's drops include the Blade - Will of Galacta costume along with related bundle content.[/p][p][b]Drops Period: September 12th, 2025, at 12: 00: 00 (UTC) to October 10th, 2025, at 09: 00: 00 (UTC)[/b][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Tournaments[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. The fourth season of the Marvel Rivals Championship is here! Dynamic nameplate designs have been introduced for champion, runner-up, and third-place. Play 10 Open Qualifiers for an exclusive spray reward. Platinum III remains the minimum sign-up rank, with faction slots for each region remaining at 2,500. Please note that, like season 3, the sign-up phase is shorter due to the season length adjustment. Stay tuned for the official schedule and check the Marvel Rivals Championship rules for details.
2. Marvel Rivals Championship Factions have been moved from the main tab under the Tournament section to within the Championship page itself, enhancing the connection between Factions and the tournament. All related functions remain unchanged.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]College Perks[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]College Perk costumes are changing to the following:
Spider-Man - Spider-Punk 2099
Luna Snow - Mirae 2099
Thor - Thor: Love and Thunder
Psylocke - Blood Kariudo
Peni Parker - Yatsukahagi
Loki - Presidential Attire
Magik - Eldritch Armor
Mantis - Jade Maiden
Mister Fantastic - The Maker
Hela - Yami no Karasu[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]All Platforms[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1.  Improved pre-match hero selection wheel; added a "Strike Squad" favorites bar for quick picks.
2. Optimized the Career page to showcase key stats for your frequently used heroes.
3. Fixed incorrect Hero Proficiency display for Lords at match settlement.  [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Maps and Modes[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1. Arakko: Slightly increased mission vehicle speed for Attacking Side in section 1 (sections 2 and 3 remain unchanged).
2. Fixed several terrain issues that could cause characters to sometimes become stuck or clip into strange areas.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][p align="justify"]1.Star-Lord's Cosmic Confusion: Fixed a rare bug where Peter's Ultimate Ability could sometimes lock onto targets behind certain cover. No more sneaky blaster shots!  
2. Winter Soldier's Armored Anomaly: Fixed a visual issue where Bucky's mechanical arm could appear distorted on some costumes in low graphics settings. Now his arm is as reliable as his aim!  [/p][p align="justify"]
The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates on the horizon in Season 4. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p]

notes.title: Loot boxes could be coming to Marvel Rivals as a dataminer finds evidence of 'multiple references to mystery box logic', and like always, players are divided
notes.content: Word on the street is that Marvel Rivals has plans for loot boxes after a dataminer uncovered evidence of mystery box logic while trawling Season 4's files. There's no official confirmation yet, but the speculation is enough to divide players... Read more.

notes.title: Coughing baby vs hydrogen bomb comes to Marvel Rivals: They just buffed Scarlet Witch's ult damage from 800 to 9,999
notes.content: We're a week out from Marvel Rivals Season 4 now, but before we can all enjoy the arrival of a new Vanguard and map, there's still some time to grind the battle pass and competitive, if you're brave enough. But before you do that, it may be a good idea to check out the new balance patch—there are some… interesting details in there... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250912 Balance Post
notes.content:
[p]The Marvel Rivals universe is shifting. Some are getting recharged, some are facing nerfs, and new team-up changes are bringing even more epic showdowns! Let's break down which heroes are getting a power boost and who's feeling the sting.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2][b]ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h2][h3][b]VANGUARD[/b][/h3][p][b]Captain America[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Cap's damage output is getting a slight downgrade.
- Remove Team-Up Anchor bonus 5% Damage boost.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Doctor Strange[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The Sorcerer Supreme is now casting faster, but he's trading a bit of survivability for offensive mystique!
- Reduce Maelstrom of Madness cooldown from 8s to 6s.
- Reduce base health from 600 to 575.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Emma Frost[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The White Queen's control and survivability are getting a little less unbreakable!
- Increase Diamond Form cooldown from 15s to 18s.
- Reduce Telepathic Pulse energy gained when hitting shields from 10/s to 5/s.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Peni Parker[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Enemies caught in Peni's webs are in for a stickier situation, and her Ultimate Ability just got slightly more threatening!
- Spider-Drone New Effect: Now slows hit enemies by 8% for 2s, each hit stacks the effect and resets the slow period, stacking up to 40%.
- Reduce Spider-Drone release interval during Ultimate Ability from 0.7s to 0.5s.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Thor[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The God of Thunder's Ultimate is getting an upgrade. More speed, new stun, greater "Bring the Thunder!"
- Increase Movement Speed during Ultimate Ability from 600 to 700.
- After Ultimate Ability lands, Stun surrounding enemies for 1s.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]DUELIST[/b][/h3][p][b]Black Panther[/b][/p][p align="justify"]T'Challa's survivability after striking a marked enemy is now less kingly.
- Reduce Bonus Health gained when striking Vibranium Marked enemies with Spirit Rend from 30 to 25.
- Reduce base health from 300 to 275.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Blade[/b][/p][p align="justify"]The Daywalker's sword just got a little sharper. More melee damage for those who hunt in the night!
- Increase Ancestral Sword damage per single slash from 22 to 24.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Magik[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Magik loses her Team-Up Anchor bonus, but gets a whole arsenal upgrade to compensate!
- Remove Team-Up Anchor bonus 15% Damage boost.
- Reduce charge time required for Magik Slash maximum damage from 1.8 s to 1.2s.
- Magik Slash New Effect: Projectile now pierces enemies and reduces Stepping Discs cooldown by 1s per enemy pierced.
- Increase Soulsword damage from 65 to 75.
- Increase Eldritch Whirl damage from 45 to 50.
- Increase Demon's Rage damage per hit from 18 to 20.
- Increase Melee Normal Attack Damage from 30 to 40.
- During Darkchild (Ultimate Ability), increase Eldritch Whirl single-hit damage from 35 to 45 and Umbral Incursion damage from 135 to 140.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Moon Knight[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Marc Spector's blade is now moon-charged for maximum chaos!
- Moon Blade now holds up to 2 charges, each taking 6s to recharge.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Psylocke[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Sai's burst damage has been slightly dialed back.
- Decrease the retrieve damage of Wing Shurikens per hit from 12 to 8.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Scarlet Witch[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Wanda's survivability and Ultimate are getting a magical upgrade.
- Can now be healed by teammates during Mystic Projection.
- Increase Reality Erasure damage from 800 to 9999.
- New Effect: Now pulls in nearby enemies (within 15m radius) during cast charge. Max pull speed up to 2.4m/s. [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Squirrel Girl[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Doreen is less of a menace from afar.
- Reduce Burst Acorn damage from 110 to 100.
- Increase the hit damage of Squirrel Blockade from 35 to 50.
- Increase Mammal Bond cooldown from 10s to 15s.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Winter Soldier[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Bucky is getting a handy improvement to his close-quarters control.
- Trooper's Fist New Effect: Second strike now applies a 1s debuff to enemies hit, preventing them from using mobility abilities.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]STRATEGIST[/b][/h3][p][b]Invisible Woman[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Sue Storm's control and Ultimate abilities just got more fantastic!
- Increase Slow effect to enemies passing through Guardian Shield from 30% to 35%.
- Increase Invisible Boundary (Ultimate Ability) healing per second from 165 to 180.
- New Effect: Slows enemies within range by 20%.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Jeff the Land Shark[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Jeff's Ultimate leaves a healing pool after use. Dive in for some aquatic rejuvenation!
- It's Jeff! (Ultimate Ability) now leaves an 8m radius Healing Pool at the point of activation that heals allies within range by 100/s. Healing Pool lasts for 8s.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Loki[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Less damage, healing, and Ultimate Ability active time for the God of Mischief.
- Reduce illusion's damage and healing ratio from 100% to 80%.
- Reduce God of Mischief (Ultimate Ability) shapeshift period from 15s to 12s. If using an active duration ability (E.g. Luna Snow's Ultimate Ability), reduce shapeshift residual period after the ability ends from 5s to 3s.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Luna Snow[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Seol Hee's Ultimate Ability duration is getting cooled down. (See, we do nerf her!) 
- Reduce Fate of Both Worlds (Ultimate Ability) duration from 12s to 10s.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Mantis[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Mantis gets a little more slippery.
- Movement Boost from Nature's Favor now decays to 0 over 2s after being hit, instead of instantly disappearing.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Ultron[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Ultron's Ultimate now deals extra pain. No defense is too strong for the AI Overlord!
- Ultimate Ability New Effect: Deals 125% damage to Bonus Health.[/p][h2][b] [/b][/h2][h2][b]TEAM-UP ABILITIES[/b][/h2][h3][b]NEW[/b][/h3][p][b]Divine Armory (Angela - Thor)[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- As the Team-Up Anchor, Angela gains 100 Health.
- Thor gains the new Thunderstrike Pike ability from his Team-Up with Angela.[/p][h3][b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]ADJUSTED OR REMOVED[/b][/h3][p][b]Arcane Order (Doctor Strange - Scarlet Witch/Magik)[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Magik joins the order and unlocks the new magical Chain of Cyttorak ability through her team-up with Doctor Strange.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Dimensional Shortcut (Magik - Psylocke)[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- This team-up has been banished to Limbo and removed from the game.
- Black Panther loses the Wakandan Master ability previously attained from his team-up with Magik.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][b]Gamma Charge (Hulk - Namor/Black Panther)[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Black Panther joins the gamma fun and gains the Gamma Vibranium Armor ability through his team-up with Hulk.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][p][b]Arcane Order (Doctor Strange - Scarlet Witch/Magik)[/b][/p][p align="justify"]Looks like the arcane magic is getting a bit weaker for Scarlet Witch.
- Reduce Sorcery Surge Explosion Damage upon hit from 12 to 6.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates on the horizon in Season 4. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The next two heroes coming to Marvel Rivals have officially been announced, and I only know who one of them is
notes.content: s usual, there's been rumours flying around about which two new heroes would be coming to Marvel Rivals Season 4 pretty much as soon as Season 3's newbies were confirmed. There was some speculation that a couple of Spider-Man's friends would be joining the roster, but now we know for sure who's ready for September 12... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Season 4 release date, Angela details, patch notes, and more
notes.content: Marvel Rivals Season 4 continues the strong pace set by the previous season but adds some much-needed quality-of-life features, along with a few things I never knew I needed. Of course, we're getting two new heroes, maps, modes, events, and a fresh battle pass to grind through, too... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals внезапно анонсировали для PlayStation 4 — выйдет уже 12 сентября
notes.content: Пока одни разработчики взяли тренд на отказ от PlayStation 4, другие наоборот заявляют о поддержке старого железа Sony. К последним относится компания NetEase, внезапно анонсировавшая сегодня шутер Marvel Rivals для PlayStation 4.

notes.title: Two more heroes have been leaked for Marvel Rivals, but unless NetEase plans to turn Deadpool into a healer, I don't want either in Season 4

notes.title: Marvel Rivals director says its 'gooner game' reputation really just reflects a commitment to authenticity: 'These all come from classic comic designs'
notes.content: Marvel Rivals has a reputation for appealing to its players' baser instincts: It had people saying 'thick thighs save lives' at one point, and Elie recently described the shooter as 'digging its heels into the gooner dirt' when it added a cache of new swimsuit skins. Despite my best efforts to escape this discourse, I've been drawn back in, as creative director Guangyun Chen has finally addressed Marvel Rivals' reputation as a "gooner game.".. Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals' bloated DPS roster won't be solved 'overnight', creative director says: 'The heroes we are currently deciding on are for a release slot next year'
notes.content: If there's one thing that Marvel Rivals unequivocally does right, it's putting together a strong hero roster. There's a cute shark, a K-pop idol, Norse gods, the Fantastic Four, the Avengers we all know and love, and many more. Despite all these great characters, Marvel Rivals has one big issue with its roster: over half of them are Duelists... Read more.

notes.title: Frame Rate Drops with NVIDIA GeForce Driver Version 580.88
notes.content: [p]Recently, we've noticed a surge in community and customer support reports regarding performance issues with NVIDIA GeForce driver versions 580.88. Players using this driver may experience abnormal drops in GPU usage, leading to noticeable frame rate drops during gameplay: a real villainous twist no hero wants. [/p][p][/p][p]Our Recommendation: [b]If you're using an NVIDIA GeForce graphics card, we strongly advise rolling back your driver version to 577.00. This will help steer clear of unexpected frame issues and keep your gameplay smooth and heroic.[/b][/p][p][url="https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/details/250995/"]GeForce Game Ready Driver 577.00 | Windows 11 | NVIDIA[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Our technical team is working closely with NVIDIA to pinpoint the root cause and implement a fix in a new driver release. Rest assured, we're assembling all our resources, Avengers-style, to resolve this as quickly as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]We are committed to addressing technical issues raised by players in the community and are working diligently to provide the best possible gaming experience this side of the Marvel Universe. Stay tuned to our official socials as more exciting updates are on the way![/p][p]  Ignite the Battle![/p]

notes.title: Marvel Rivals 3.5 sneaks in one very minor change to appease those who hate the new end-of-match overview, and it works
notes.content: fter calls that Marvel Rivals' end-of-match screens were barebones, and that's if we're being generous, NetEase finally upgraded the UI with the launch of Season 3.0. In fact, it was one of my favourite additions, finally letting me track my level, battle pass, challenge, and accessory point progress, as well as all the events that are always going on, without needing to head back to the menu... Read more.

notes.title: 70 seconds makes all the difference under the new Marvel Rivals approach to rage-quitters
notes.content:
Techno-loving hollowtooth Blade has joined the playable cast of Marvel Rivals, but he's not what I find most interesting about the free-to-play shooter's latest update. Developers NetEase Games have introduced a new system of penalties for ragequitters, keyboard-away-frommers, and other craven scumbags who abandon a competitive mode match early on because the dishwasher's overflowing, or similar.

Read more

notes.title: Blade is Marvel Rivals' answer to an intentionally broken meta, though he may usher in a whole new issue
notes.content: If there's one gripe that I've had with Marvel Rivals since its launch, it's that everything is overtuned, seemingly intentionally by NetEase. High DPS means you need high, consistent healing to counteract it. If you're not bursting an enemy down in a nanosecond, chances are they'll get to cover and be back to full health faster than you can say "bullshit". And nothing has been worse than almost every Strategist's ultimate being a straightforward no one dies for ten whole seconds... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals is finally giving more competitive compensation to players struck down by rage-quitting teammates or friends with hamster-powered Wi-Fi
notes.content: We're just days away from Marvel Rivals Season 3.5, and with it comes a bunch of new stuff, including Blade, a limited-time event, and a ton of changes to competitive play, some of which may make matches slightly easier for low-elo players... Read more.

If you believe you were wrongly penalized, please contact customer support for a prompt review.[/p][p] [/p][h2][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]All Platforms[/b][/h3][p]1. Rank reward Nameplate Frames can now be displayed in more areas (lobby, career, friends, faction, leaderboards, gifts, invites, custom games, etc).[/p][p]2. Hero display in team lobby now supports camera scroll.[/p][p]3. Clicking on your nameplate while in a team lobby can now quickly switch styles.[/p][p]4. Improved Venom's Tickle Me Pink emote animation for his default costume.[/p][p]5. The "Special" tab in the Store now lets you browse all available Moods, Emoji, and unique Emotes.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Graphics & Performance[/b][/h3][h3][b]PC[/b][/h3][p]1. PC Shader Compilation Rework: The mandatory shader compilation wait on first launch has been removed. Instead, essential global shaders will now preload in the background after installation/update. (Shader preload speed depends on your GPU, entering a match before preloading competes may cause performance issues, including stuttering, network lag, rendering errors, or crashes.)[/p][p]2. The performance test tool now provides graphics settings optimization recommendations based on your test results.[/p][p]3. In-game UI animation details will now automatically adjust based on your effects detail settings to improve overall performance.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Maps and Modes[/b][/h3][p]1. Fixed several terrain issues that could cause characters to sometimes become stuck or clip into strange areas.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3][p]1. Jumping the Gun: Polished up a minor bug where Emma Frost, Iron Fist, Phoenix, and Wolverine were out-leaping the competition with slightly higher jump heights. Now everyone's jump is perfectly balanced, as all things should be![/p][p]2. Iron Fist's Silent Sanctuary: Resolved an issue where Lin Lie's Harmony Recovery would sometimes end without playing its ending sound effect. The Iron Fist can now find his inner peace with the proper zen, no more silent retreats in K'un-Lun![/p][p]3. Venom & Spider-Man Slinging in Style: Spidey and The Symbiote can now set separate keybinds for simple and manual swinging. Choose your web-slinging style on the fly![/p][p]4. Panther & Wolverine's Sneaky Sounds: Enhanced the audio cues for enemy Black Panther and Wolverine when they're sneaking up for a surprise attack. Now, when these clawed kings are on the prowl, you might hear them coming. Predator awareness up![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and with Season 3.5 dropping, we have plenty more surprises and changes in store. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Tank mains are eating well in the Marvel Rivals 3.5 patch notes, except for Thor, God of Short Circuits
notes.content: We're officially in the swing of the faster seasonal update cycle, seeing a brand-new character each and every month, alongside a suite of new, tweaked, and retired team-up abilities. To make matters even worse, it's time for the Marvel Rivals Season 3.5 patch notes to stir the pot even more... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250808 Balance Post
notes.content: [p]Even in the multiverse, change is the only constant, and our heroes are always evolving to keep the fight fair, fierce, and fun! From thunder gods to cosmic crusaders, our beloved heroes are getting a tune-up (or a slight nerf). Let's see what's new![/p][p][/p][h2][b]ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h2][p] [/p][h3][b]VANGUARD[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p][u][b]Doctor Strange[/b][/u][/p][p]The Master of the Mystic Arts is getting a little oomph in his arsenal![/p][p]l Increase Daggers of Denak projectile charges from 8 to 10.[/p][p]l Reduce Cloak of Levitation cooldown from 15s to 12s.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Groot[/u][/b][/p][p]I am Groot! (Translation: Groot's got slightly more reach and a bigger effect radius.)[/p][p]l Increase Vine Strike range from 20m to 22m.[/p][p]l Increase Flora Colossus effect range radius from 20m to 24m.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Magneto[/u][/b][/p][p]The Master of Magnetism's shields and survivability are getting a slight tune-down.[/p][p]l Reduce Metal Bulwark and Iron Bulwark Shield Value from 300 to 250.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Thor[/u][/b][/p][p]The God of Thunder's gameplay gets a jolt of improvement and utility![/p][p]l Gain a fixed 1 Thorforce upon exiting the Awakening Rune awakened state.[/p][p]l Lightning Realm New Effect: Enemies leaving its boundary are Grounded for 2s, restricting aerial abilities.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]DUELIST[/b][/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b][u]Black Panther[/u][/b][/p][p]After addressing hit detection, T'Challa's Spirit Rend is getting a longer cooldown.[/p][p]l Increase Spirit Rend cooldown from 8s to 10s.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Iron Fist[/u][/b][/p][p]With his Team-Up Anchor removed, Lin Lie's raw power gets a slight boost to even things out.[/p][p]l Increase Jeet Kune Do's fifth strike damage from 50 to 55.[/p][p]l Increase Yat Jee Chung Kuen percentage damage of the enemy's Max Health per strike from 2.1% to 2.7%.[/p][p]l Adjust Harmony Recovery Bonus Health decay start time from 1s to 2s.[/p][p]l Increase K'un-Lun Kick's first strike damage from 30 to 35.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Star-Lord[/u][/b][/p][p]Peter Quill gets a little more staying power in the heat of battle![/p][p]l Gain 25 Bonus Health when using Stellar Shift (max 25), which lasts for 3s before decaying to 0 over 1s.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Wolverine[/u][/b][/p][p]Logan's ultimate is a little bit tougher to unleash; time to earn that berserker barrage![/p][p]l Increase the energy cost of Last Stand (Ultimate Ability) from 2800 to 3400.[/p][p]l Lifesteal gained from the Primal Flame - Phoenix Warrior Team-Up Ability no longer contributes to Wolverine's Ultimate Ability energy.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Spider-Man[/u][/b][/p][p]Spidey's Ultimate just got stickier, and deadlier![/p][p]l Increase Damage per second of Spectacular Spin (Ultimate Ability) from 150 to 170.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]STRATEGIST[/b][/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b][u]Adam Warlock[/u][/b][/p][p]Adam gets a slight cosmic buff to his Ultimate Ability frequency and strength, plus increased healing.[/p][p]l Reduce the energy cost of Karmic Revival (Ultimate Ability) from 5000 to 4700.[/p][p]l Karmic Revival New Effect: Revived allies gain Bonus Health equal to 70% of Maximum Heath, which lasts for 5s before decaying to 0 over 2s.[/p][p]l Cosmic Cluster New Effect: Each hit now reduces Avatar Life Stream charge times by 0.3s.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b][u]Cloak & Dagger[/u][/b][/p][p]Ty and Tandy's Ultimate Ability now takes a bit more energy to unleash their Eternal Bond![/p][p]l Increase the energy cost of Eternal Bond (Ultimate Ability) from 4000 to 4300.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Mantis[/u][/b][/p][p]A new Team-Up Anchor effect for Mantis, but her base healing gets a gentle nerf to balance the cosmic scales.[/p][p]l Increase healing by 10% with the new Team-Up Anchor effect.[/p][p]l Reduce Healing Flower's Healing Over Time effect from 12.5/s to 10/s.[/p][p]l Reduce Life Energy Blast projectile charges from 20 to 15[/p][p]l Increase Soul Resurgence (Ultimate Ability) excess healing to Bonus Health conversion rate from 0.7 to 1.[/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3][b]TEAM-UP ABILITIES[/b][/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]NEW[/b][/p][p]Duality Dance (Adam Warlock - Luna Snow)[/p][p]l Luna Snow unlocks the new Light & Shadow Karma ability from her Team-Up with Adam Warlock.[/p][p] [/p][p]Vibrant Vitality (Mantis - Groot/Loki)[/p][p]l As the Team-Up Anchor, Mantis gains a 10% increase in healing effects.[/p][p]l Groot gains the new Wild Wall ability from his Team-Up with Mantis.[/p][p]l Loki gains the new Deific Blessing ability from his Team-Up with Mantis.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]ADJUSTED OR REMOVED[/b][/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]Atlas Bond (Iron Fist - Luna Snow)[/b][/u][/p][p]The bonds have been broken.[/p][p]l The Team-Up Anchor effect for Iron Fist has been removed, along with the Atlas Bond Team-Up Ability.[/p][p]l Luna Snow loses the Frozen Chi ability from her Team-Up with Iron Fist.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]Chilling Assault (Luna Snow- Hawkeye/Iron Fist)[/b][/u][/p][p]l Iron Fist joins the assault and unlocks the new Lunar Chi ability through his Team-Up with Luna Snow.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]Guardian Revival (Adam Warlock - Mantis/Star-Lord)[/b][/u][/p][p]l The Guardian Revival Team-Up is being laid to rest.[/p][p]l Mantis loses the Nature's Soul ability previously gained from her Team-Up with Adam Warlock.[/p][p]l Star-Lord loses the Leader's Soul ability previously gained from his Team-Up with Adam Warlock.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]Lunar Force (Cloak & Dagger - Moon Knight/Blade)[/b][/u][/p][p]l Blade launches into Lunar Force and gains the New Moon ability through his Team-Up with Cloak & Dagger.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]Ragnarok Rebirth (Hela - Thor/Loki)[/b][/u][/p][p]l Loki has other plans in stall and loses the Laufeyson Reborn ability previously gained from his Team-Up with Hela.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][u][b]Rocket Network (Rocket Raccoon - Peni Parker/Star-Lord)[/b][/u][/p][p]l Star-Lord connects to the network and unlocks a new Astral Jump ability through his Team-Up with Rocket Raccoon.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][p] [/p][p][u][b]Ever-Burning Bond (Human Torch - Spider-Man)[/b][/u][/p][p]We've increased Spider-Man's combo potential after using this Team-Up.[/p][p]l Reduced the backflip distance after activation from 12m to 7m, allowing for more reliable follow-ups with moves like Amazing Combo.[/p]

notes.title: Rejoice, Tank players: Marvel Rivals has nerfed Wolverine, a mere five days after buffing him because it brought 'a bit too much heat to Vanguards'

notes.title: 'Cease this behaviour immediately': Marvel Rivals is finally punishing smurfs by forcing them—and some innocent players—to smurf
notes.content: There's been a serious smurf infestation in Marvel Rivals for some time now, and sadly, I'm not talking about the little blue guys. I can't remember when it all started, but it's one of the many problems that came over from Overwatch, as streamers started doing bronze to GM trend videos... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250717 Balance Post
notes.content: [p]In the recently launched Season 3, we observed that Wolverine's new Team-Up Ability with Phoenix has been bringing a bit too much heat to Vanguards. This duo's combined power has led to battles for Vanguards feeling less like a hero's journey and more like a mutiny, potentially sidelining key Vanguard heroes. To restore balance and keep the fight epic, we're nerfing Wolverine's Team-Up Ability and dialing down his threat level against the Vanguards in this update.[/p][p]We'll keep a close eye on the hero ecosystem and your battles, so stay tuned for more balance adjustments in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][b]DUELIST[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Wolverine[/p][p]Time to temper Logan's rage and slightly reduce his survivability.[/p][p]-Increase Berserk Claw Strike Base Damage from 6 to 8. Reduce Percentage Damage per attack at maximum Rage from 4.5% to 3.5%.[/p][p]-Increase Regenerative Healing Factor cooldown from 90s to 105s. Increase cooldown reduction from 10s to 12s when participating in KOs.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]TEAM-UP ABILITIES[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Primal Flame (Phoenix - Wolverine)[/p][p]Our fiery mutant duo's bond has been a little too hot to handle. So we're cooling down Wolverine's healing when teaming up with Phoenix.[/p][p]-Reduce Lifesteal gained during Phoenix Warrior from 33% to 25%.[/p]

notes.title: A fan favourite X-Men hero has just been name-dropped in Marvel Rivals, and while I want her to join the fight, I just don't know if it would be possible
notes.content: Phoenix is the latest hero to get added to Marvel Rivals as part of the new season. While this character seems as powerful as is to be expected, I'm far more interested in what she has to say... Read more.

notes.title: How to get accessories in Marvel Rivals
notes.content: While the new ultimate customisation feature in Season 3 of Marvel Rivals is cool, I think accessories are much more fun. These are little charms that you can attach to your character that also add a cute little animation above your KO prompt, though it's not quite as extensive as I'd hoped—or what you'd expect from other games, like Overwatch 2. The good news is that they're actually free, unlike most of Marvel Rivals' customisation options... Read more.

notes.title: How to customise ultimate abilities in Marvel Rivals
notes.content: Marvel Rivals is constantly adding new ways to give us more control over how our characters look, from heaps of premium cosmetics to costume customisation in Season 2. NetEase has taken this a step further now with ultimate customisation, which lets you tweak ultimate ability VFX and UI. Just like the addition of customisable costumes, however, it's not as simple as you'd hope... Read more.

notes.title: If Marvel Rivals doesn't want to reward me with fancy skins for my hard work, then I hope it'll at least give me some of Season 3's new customisation features
notes.content: It's safe to assume that Marvel Rivals makes bank from its microtransactions. Its hero costumes put other games to shame, with incredible designs and even unique effects to go along with them, most of the time. Season 2 added a handful of colour palettes for select skins, while Season 3 brings charms and custom ultimate ability visuals. These new features are exactly what I want. I love getting to customise my characters in as many ways as possible. What I don't love is just how unrewarding it can all feel... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals' next hero is the complete package, as Phoenix packs enough firepower to cut through any Strategist backline
notes.content: Like clockwork, Marvel Rivals' Season 3 comes around and throws a new OP hero into the cage fight of superhumans, gods, and (checks notes) man with gun. This time, the new arrival is Phoenix, and while she may not be as all-powerful as her comic counterpart, she'll still tear through your divers and Strategists... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals digs its heels into the gooner dirt as it reveals five new swimsuit skins, giving the people what they want: Punisher in a Speedo
notes.content: Summer's here, and you know what that means: swimsuit skins, swimsuit skins everywhere. And this year, Marvel Rivals is coming out swinging with five new skins, all of which look amazing and are just as scandalous as you'd expect from NetEase... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals' most exciting change in Season 3 is removing the need to grind the game every single day
notes.content: When I booted up the Marvel Rivals preview build for Season 3 for the first time, I was, of course, dying to try out Phoenix right away. New heroes are always the stars of the show, and that's no different here... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals players may soon be able to vote on what heroes they want added: 'We will use them as an important factor in our planning'
notes.content: Marvel Rivals has a monumental task in front of it after promising players a new hero every month and a half. So far, the devs have made good on their promise with new heroes every half-season, the latest being Phoenix and Blade, with the former arriving in under a week for the start of Season 3... Read more.

notes.title: Phoenix's terrifying team-up in Marvel Rivals Season 3 has me starting a campaign to get Wolverine banned in all my matches
notes.content: I've played Marvel Rivals almost every day since launch, and while I'm far from the best, most consistent player, I've hovered around the Grandmaster regions in competitive, peaking at Celestial 2. At times, trying to take Rivals seriously and play competitively has been an act of self-targeted psychic damage, largely because the hero balance has historically been absolutely terrible... Read more.

This season, we're igniting some fiery fun with brand-new Nameplate Frame rewards for Diamond and Platinum ranks.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Mission System Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]1. Daily Missions Removed: Their Chrono Token rewards will be redistributed to other missions.[/p][p]2. More Mission Types: New missions added, while excessive hero-specific missions have been removed.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Systems[/b][/h3][p]1. Accessories: Earn Accessory Points in matches and redeem them in the Shop for hero-specific accessories.[/p][p]2. Discord Integration: Reconnect your Discord account after the update to receive 100 Units and unlock new features: Chat with Discord friends in-game and message in-game friends via Discord when not in the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New In Store[/b][/h3][p]1. New Costume: Phoenix - Chaos Phoenix Bundle[/p][p]2. New Emoji: Phoenix - Default Bundle[/p][p]3. New Costume Colors: Scarlet Witch - Immortal Sovereign, Jeff the Land Shark - Sunshine Land Shark, Invisible Woman - Malice, Rocket Raccoon - Sunshine Raccoon[/p][p]4. New Ultimate Ability VFX: Scarlet Witch - Immortal Sovereign, Jeff the Land Shark - Sunshine Land Shark[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Twitch Drops[/b][/h3][p]As Season 3.0 kicks off, get ready for a new round of Twitch Drops. notes.title: Marvel Rivals' updated hero hot list reveals the most-played and highest win-rate characters, and it's good news for Support players
notes.content: Every new season of Marvel Rivals brings more terrifying metas and heroes that manage to tower above the rest. And with just a week before Season 3 lands, NetEase has released an updated version of the hero hot list so everyone can compare notes and see which heroes they should jump on for the remaining second season... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Phoenix: All the key details about the upcoming hero
notes.content: The arrival of Phoenix (also known as Jean Grey) in Marvel Rivals not only sees a powerful new DPS burn the meta to the ground, but also kicks off the faster pace going forward. From now on, we'll see a new character every single month, and there's no better way to start than with Phoenix, one of the most anticipated characters since she was leaked a while back... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Season 3 patch notes: All buffs and nerfs
notes.content: new hero every month sounds like a balancing nightmare to me, though the Marvel Rivals Season 3 patch notes bring some great changes across the roster Though not quite as severe as what we've seen in the past, these more targeted buffs and nerfs are generally a good sign, as they mean the balance is settling into a healthier state. This is key if NetEase really is deadset on continuing to release so many new heroes... Read more.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250711 Balance Post
notes.content: [p]Even heroes need a little fine-tuning. We've zapped, buffed, and balanced. Let's see what's changing in Season 3.0!  [/p][h1][b]ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h1][p] [/p][h2][b]VANGUARD[/b][/h2][p] [/p][h3]Emma Frost[/h3][p]Looks like the White Queen is trading a bit of offense for more glam! Her Damage and her Survivability in Diamond Form are taking a slight hit.[/p][list][*][p]Reduce Telepathic Pulse Damage at 99 energy from 120/s to 110/s and from 150/s to 140/s at 100 energy.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduce Diamond Form Damage Reduction from 30% to 25%.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduce the energy cost of Psionic Seduction (Ultimate Ability) from 3700 to 3400.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]The Thing[/h3][p]We're not afraid to say it... IT'S CLOBBERIN' TIME! Now with smoother moves and more utility! Time for more pain with your brothers and sisters in arms![/p][list][*][p]New Ability Battle Blitz: The Thing leaps toward enemies, gaining 25% Damage Reduction. Leap targeting distance to enemies is 20m.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Stone Haymaker New Effect: Knocks down hit flying enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Venom[/h3][p]Venom's got a stickier grip! His control after diving in is now slightly more terrifying.[/p][list][*][p]Increase Cellular Corrosion enemy slow effect from 15% to 25%.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3][b]DUELIST[/b][/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Human Torch[/h3][p]Flame on… but mind the heat! Johnny's getting a Team-Up Anchor effect but a little less firepower to balance things out.[/p][list][*][p]Reduce Fire Cluster Damage per projectile from 6 to 5.5.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduce Supernova (Ultimate Ability) activation shockwave Damage from 80 to 75 and Fire Tornadoes DoT from 120/s to 110/s.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Add Team-Up Anchor bonus 5% Damage boost.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Iron Man[/h3][p]Tony's slightly powering down with reduced Damage output and a longer wait for his Ultimate.[/p][list][*][p]Reduce the first two Repulsor Blast hits from 40 to 35 and from 50 to 45 while in Armor Overdrive.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increase energy cost of Invincible Pulse Cannon (Ultimate Ability) from 2800 to 3400.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Mister Fantastic[/h3][p]The stretchy genius gets slightly less tanky in his Inflated state.[/p][list][*][p]Reduce Inflated state Bonus Health from 400 to 350.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Namor[/h3][p]The Sub-Mariner surges forward with smoother aim and slightly sharper tridents![/p][list][*][p]Increase Trident of Neptune Projectile Damage from 70 to 75 and Projectile Speed from 120m/s to 150m/s.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increase Wrath of the Seven Seas Projectile Speed from 120m/s to 150m/s.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Scarlet Witch[/h3][p]Wanda's Ultimate just got a little more hex-tra![/p][list][*][p]Reduce max slow rate during Reality Erasure (Ultimate Ability) charge period from 35% to 25% and increase Damage from 750 to 850.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Spider-Man[/h3][p]Web-warriors rejoice! Spidey loses his Team-Up Anchor bonus but gains a new Team-Up Ability and a bit more bite.[/p][list][*][p]Increase 'Get Over Here!' kick Damage when pulled to enemies from 50 to 55.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increase Spider-Power midair Damage from 50 to 55.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increase Amazing Combo Damage from 55 to 60.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]The Punisher[/h3][p]Frank's turret is losing some sting, and his Ultimate is going to need more juice.[/p][list][*][p]Reduce Culling Turret Projectile Damage from 12 to 10, and decrease the Spell Field Damage from 12 to 10.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increase the energy cost of Final Judgement (Ultimate Ability) from 3400 to 3700.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Winter Soldier[/h3][p]Bucky's getting a little more dangerous from downtown.[/p][list][*][p]Adjust Roterstern Damage Falloff maximum at 40m from 60% to 70%.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Wolverine[/h3][p]Logan's control frequency is taking a slight hit as he now needs more time to sharpen those claws between leaps.[/p][list][*][p]Increase Feral Leap strike duration from 4s to 5s and increase its cooldown from 12s to 15s.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]STRATEGIST[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Invisible Woman[/h3][p]Sue's healing is a little more reliable, now that's fantastic![/p][list][*][p]Increase Orb Projection healing on launch from 40 to 45 and damage from 20 to 25. Reduce healing on return from 40 to 35 and damage from 20 to 15[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Loki[/h3][p]The God of Mischief needs slightly more energy for his Ultimate. Guess he's been up to too many tricks![/p][list][*][p]Increase the energy cost of God of Mischief (Ultimate Ability) from 4000 to 4300.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Mantis[/h3][p]Mantis's healing touch grows, and her Ultimate is more potent, but its frequency is reduced.[/p][list][*][p]Healing Flower New Effect: Heals allies by 2.5%/s. Reduce base healing from 20/s to 12.5/s.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increase energy cost of Soul Resurgence (Ultimate Ability) from 3700 to 4300. Increase Bonus Max Health from 100 to 150.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Ultron[/h3][p]Ultron's going to have to update his software as his defenses are taking a slight hit, and he's a little less of a team player (which seems fine by him) in this patch.[/p][list][*][p]Reduced Dynamic Flight acceleration effect time from 8s to 6s.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reduce Imperative: Firewall Bonus Health to self from 75 to 65 and to allies from 55 to 50.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]TEAM-UP ABILITIES[/b][/h1][p][b] [/b][/p][h2][b]NEW:[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Ever-Burning Bond (Human Torch - Spider-Man)[/h3][list][*][p]With great friendship comes great firepower! As the Team-Up Anchor, Human Torch gains a 5% boost in damage output.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Spider-Man unlocks the new Inferno Blast ability through his team-up with Human Torch.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Primal Flame (Phoenix - Wolverine)[/h3][list][*][p]Snikt! Now with a side of cosmic fire. As the Team-Up Anchor, Phoenix gains a 10% boost in damage output.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Wolverine gains the new Phoenix Warrior ability through his Team-Up with Phoenix.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][b]ADJUSTED OR REMOVED[/b][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]ESU Alumnus (Spider-Man - Squirrel Girl)[/h3][list][*][p]Time for these two to graduate on to bigger and better things. The Team-Up Anchor effect for Spider-Man has been removed, along with the ESU Alumnus Team-Up Ability.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Squirrel Girl loses the Webbed Acorn ability previously gained from her Team-Up with Spider-Man.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Stark Protocol (Iron Man - Ultron/Squirrel Girl)[/h3][list][*][p]Squirrel Girl joins this tech Team-Up! Squirrel Girl gains the new Squirrel Missile ability from her Team-Up with Iron Man.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Storming Ignition (Storm - Human Torch)[/h3][list][*][p]The fire is out and the storm has passed on this Team-Up.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Storm loses the Burning Hurricane ability gained from her Team-Up with Human Torch.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Human Torch loses the Omega Fire ability gained from his Team-Up with Storm.[/p][/*][/list][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]Symbiote Shenanigans (Venom - Jeff the Land Shark/Hela)[/h3][list][*][p]The Goddess of Death joins in on the shenanigans. Maximum mayhem, now with extra bite![/p][list][*][p]Increase Guardian of the Deep maximum Bonus Health from 50 to 100 and max tendril link period from 3s to 5s.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update to NVIDIA Driver Version 576.80 to Significantly Reduce GPU Crashes
notes.content:
[p]Since the game's launch, we've received extensive feedback from the community and customer support channels regarding frequent GPU crashes affecting players using NVIDIA graphics cards.[/p][p][/p][p]Upon identifying this issue, our technical team worked swiftly to pinpoint the root cause and began collaborating with NVIDIA's engineering team to implement a fix in a new driver release.[/p][p][/p][p]We're happy to report that [b]updating your NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready Driver to version 576.80[/b] through the NVIDIA App can significantly reduce the likelihood of GPU crashes. This driver version addresses two major crash issues:[/p][p][/p][p]· Shader Cache Overflow: Since launch, players using NVIDIA graphics cards may have experienced crashes after several matches due to shader cache overflow at the driver level.[/p][p][/p][p]· Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling: Since driver version 572.40, players using GeForce RTX 40 series and GeForce RTX 50 series graphics cards may experience crashes if "Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling" is disabled in Windows system settings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We strongly recommend all players using NVIDIA graphics cards update to version 576.80 or later to improve game stability. Our internal testing shows a major reduction in GPU-related crashes with this update.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Your feedback has been vital. Our team continually strives to tackle technical issues with the precision of Stark's tech and the resolve of Captain America. We're committed to providing you with the best gaming experience this side of the Marvel Universe. Stay tuned to our official socials as more exciting updates are on the way!

Ignite the Battle![/p][p]- Marvel Rivals Team[/p]

6. The Career System now supports showcasing more custom content and stats.

Availability: 2025/5/30, 09: 00: 00 ~ 2025/7/11, 09: 00: 00 (UTC)

[h3][b]Tournament Rooms & Custom Games[/b][/h3]

1. We've added new room name and password copy functions.
2. Added a new "Host Only" Move Permissions setting. After selecting this, only the host can rearrange player spots.
3. During the ban/pick phase for Tournament Mode (Basic or Advanced), a small icon will now mark the Captain responsible for choosing on both sides. The captain can right-click teammates to delegate banning duties.
4. For matches launched from Tournament Rooms, the host now has an "Immediately End Match" option in the ESC menu. After confirming via a double-check prompt, the match will be terminated instantly.
5. Added a new Auto-Select server node feature in Tournament Rooms. When enabled, the system will automatically choose the best node based on the network conditions of both teams. Note: This feature is still experimental and may not always work best.
[h3][b]Spectator System[/b][/h3]
1. Added new toggle options for specific visual effects. Spectators can now control the visibility of character outlines, health bars, and names in the spectator settings.
2. Free-cam spectator view now includes a collision toggle. When enabled, the camera obeys collision rules and won't clip through scene geometry.


[h3][b]PC[/b][/h3]

1.An all-new Performance Test feature is now live! Access it through Display - Settings to run a stress test on your GPU, CPU, and other hardware and quickly identify performance bottlenecks.

[h1][b]Fixes and Optimizations[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]All Platforms[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where pressing shortcut keys for spray/emotes didn't work on first launch. Previously, players had to open the selection wheel once before these shortcuts activated.  

[h3][b]Maps and Modes[/b][/h3]

1. Fixed several terrain issues that could cause characters to sometimes become stuck or clip into strange areas.
2. Resolved various problems with broken collisions, floating objects, etc.
3. Addressed multiple map sound effect issues.

[h3][b]Heroes[/b][/h3]

1. Flux Frequencies: Fixed a bug where Emma Frost's Telepathic Pulse could not be maintained and failed to gain energy when striking Groot's walls. Now, her attack hits with tree-mend-ous power!  
2. Webbed Wonders: Resolved an issue with the speed and effectiveness of multiple Peni Parker's overlayed webs stacking, which converted overflow healing into Bonus Health beyond expectations. No more unexpected health from this "web of deceit"!  
3. Loki's Layered Lunacy: Fixed an issue in Loki's Regeneration Domain where those of his self and his illusions could continuously stack healing beyond expectations. The only thing stacking now is Loki's charm, not his healing. Mischief managed!  
4. Strange's Portal Puzzle: Fixed a glitch causing Doctor Strange's portals to sometimes send heroes to unexpected locations. No more sudden detours into unexpected side quests!  
5. Punisher's Phantom Focus: Resolved a bug in the Warrior Falls spawn room where The Punisher's passive skill could inadvertently reveal enemy outlines. Justice now strikes without unnecessary spoilers!  
6. Tangled Webs: Fixed an issue at the Frozen Airfield where webs from Peni Parker's Ultimate Ability would sometimes drop beneath the terrain when the stage started to move. Her arsenal of tech and webs now stays on target.  
7. Vibranium Velocity: Fixed a bug with Black Panther's Spirit Rend where, after using it to down Winter Soldier in mid-Trooper's Fist, subsequent Spirit Rend uses could behave erratically. T'Challa's pounce now hits with the unwavering precision of a Wakandan king, swift and relentless!  
8. Panther's Stealthy Surge: Addressed a rare issue where, under poor network conditions, if Black Panther unleashed his Ultimate Ability immediately after ending wall-climbing, it occasionally faltered while still consuming energy. His attack now as smooth and unstoppable as a panther's prowl through the night.  
9. Cosmic Character Conundrum: Fixed a deceptive exploit in Doom Match where Adam Warlock could switch characters post-respawn using a special maneuver. His cosmic transformations now stick strictly to the realms of destiny and stellar justice!  
[h3][b]PC[/b][/h3]

1. Fixed issues with the experimental "Switch Shader Compilation Mode" where screen distortions or unprepared materials appeared black under certain conditions.  

The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates on the horizon. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more!

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Version 20250530 Balance Post
notes.content:
With great power there must also come great responsibility... and sometimes, a little bit of nerfing. Let's check out what's new in this heroic update!

[h1][b]ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]VANGUARD[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Captain America[/b][/h3]
Cap is taking a slight hit to his survivability and Ultimate frequency. Guess even Super Soldiers need a breather!
[*]Adjust base health from 600 to 575.
[*]Increase the delay of shield recovery from 2s to 4s after unleashing Living Legend.
[*]Increase the energy cost of Freedom Charge (Ultimate Ability) from 2800 to 3100.

[h3][b]Doctor Strange[/b][/h3]
Stephen will receive a slight boost in the damage of his standard abilities.
[*]Adjust the damage falloff of Daggers of Denak from starting at 10m and reducing to 62.5% at 20m to starting at 10m and reducing to 80% at 20m.
[*]Remove the range damage falloff of Maelstrom of Madness.

[h3][b]Emma Frost[/b][/h3]
The White Queen's range is increasing, but her defenses and Diamond Form damage are taking a hit! You win some, you lose some, darlings!
[*]Increase the range of Telepathic Pulse from 15.5m to 18m.
[*]Decrease the shield value of Mind's Aegis from 500 to 400.
[*]Increase the cooldown of Carbon Crush from 5s to 6s.
[*]Decrease the hit damage of Crystal Kick from 50 to 40, and decrease the extra damage dealt when propelling the enemies into the wall from 100 to 90.

[h3][b]Groot[/b][/h3]
He is still Groot...but with less damage and with less frequent Ironwood Walls. Looks like the Flora Colossus needs some trimming!
[*]Decrease the damage of Vine Strike per hit from 70 to 65.
[*]Increase Ironwood Wall's cooldown from 8s to 12s.

[h3][b]Magneto[/b][/h3]
The Master of Magnetism will receive a slight boost to standard damage abilities. He's really going to attract some wins now!
[*]Increase the charging speed of rings from 4s/stack to 3s/stack.

[h3][b]Thor[/b][/h3]
By Odin's beard! Thor's abilities are getting a tweak, but his survivability is taking a minor hit!
[*]Adjust Hammer Throw ability effect to a standard ability. Remove the Thorforce cost and the universal cooldown. Adjust the ability cooldown to 6s. Thor gains 1 Thorforce from each Hammer Throw enemy hit. Decrease the throw hit damage from 70 to 45, and the return damage from 30 to 20.
[*]Decrease the shield value gained when consuming Thorforce. Adjust the Bonus Health gained from each Thorforce consumed from 100 to 75 and adjust the maximum Bonus Health from 200 to 150.

[h2][b]DUELIST[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Hawkeye[/b][/h3]
Clint's getting a boost to his regular hits! Looks like the Archer's aim is getting sharper!

[*]Increase the base damage of his arrow from 32 to 34.
[*]Increase the projectile damage of Blast Arrow from 15 to 16; Increase the spell field damage from 32 to 34.
[*]Increase the maximum focus from 70 to 75. Increase the charging speed when aiming at an enemy from 100/s to 108/s and charge falloff speed from 30/s to 32/s.

[h3][b]Hela[/b][/h3]
The Goddess of Death is getting a slight increase in her sustained damage! Looks like she's ready to reign supreme!
[*]Increase the charge capacity of the Nightsword Thorn from 8 to 10.

[h3][b]Human Torch[/b][/h3]
Flame on... but with less damage and survivability! Sorry, Johnny, looks like you're getting a little less heat!
[*]Reduce the damage of Fire Cluster from 7 per hit to 6 per hit.
[*]Increase the charge speed of Blazing Blast from 2s to 3s.
[*]Decrease the shield value gained from Flaming Meteor from 75 to 50 and increase the cooldown from 15s to 20s.

[h3][b]Iron Fist[/b][/h3]
Lin Lie's taking a bit of a hit to both his damage and survivability.
[*]Lower the Dragon's Defense damage blocked Bonus Health conversion rate from 1.5 to 1.3. Decrease the maximum Bonus Health converted from damage blocked from 200 to 175. Slightly decrease the dash distance of Yat Jee Chung Kuen in the z-axis direction when there is no target.
[*]Reduce Dragon's Defense cooldown reduction from Jeet Kune Do hits from 1.5s to 1s.

[h3][b]Iron Man[/b][/h3]
Iron Man is seeing a reduction in his Repulsor Blast damage and burst survivability. Time for a new suit upgrade?

Remove Iron Man's Gamma Overdrive from the Gamma Charge Team-Up; Gain a new Team-Up Anchor effect from the Stark Protocol Team-Up.
[*]Decrease the projectile damage of the third Repulsor Blast from 50 to 45, and decrease the Spell Field Damage from 60 to 55.
[*]Reduce Armor Overdrive maximum Bonus Health from 100 to 50.

[h3][b]Namor[/b][/h3]
The Sub-Mariner's defenses will be sinking a bit, but his Monstro Spawns are getting stronger, and his Ultimate is bigger! Time to flood the battlefield!
[*]Increase the Cooldown of Blessing of the Deep from 15s to 20s.
[*]Expand Horn of Proteus (Ultimate Ability) inner circle radius from 3m to 3.5m and outer circle radius from 8m to 9m. Decrease the outer circle radius hit damage from 200 to 180.
[*]Adjust Monstro Spawn Damage Falloff from starting at 20m, reducing to 30% at 40m, to starting at 20m, reducing to 50% at 40m.

[h3][b]Psylocke[/b][/h3]
Sai will take a slight dip in her burst damage ability and survivability.
[*]Decrease the retrieval damage of Wing Shurikens from 14 to 12 per hit.
[*]Decrease the Invisibility Duration of Psychic Stealth from 3s to 2s.

[h3][b]Squirrel Girl[/b][/h3]
Squirrel Girl is getting some love! Better acorns, shorter cooldowns, and improved ability release feel! This is nuts!
[*]Increase the capacity of Burst Acorn from 10 to 12. 
[*]Decrease the cooldown of Mammal Bond from 12s to 10s.
[*]Optimize the user experience of Squirrel Blockade, Tail Bounce, and Unbeatable Squirrel Tsunami (Ultimate Ability).

[h3][b]Star-Lord[/b][/h3]
Peter is having his Ultimate frequency reduced, but his Ultimate power increased. Time to bust a move!
[*]Increase the energy cost of Galactic Legend (Ultimate Ability) from 3100 to 3400. Extend the maximum target range from 30m to 40m. Adjust the damage falloff from reducing to 60% at 40m to reducing to 75% at 40m.

[h3][b]Storm[/b][/h3]
We slightly improving her Ultimate Ability intensity.
[*]Increase damage of Omega Hurricane (Ultimate Ability) from 150/s to 160/s.

[h3][b]The Punisher[/b][/h3]
Punisher's getting a boost to his mid-to-long range damage and a slight mobility buff during his Ultimate! Time to lock and load!

[*]Reduce the movement slow rate of Final Judgement (Ultimate Ability) from 20% to 10% when not firing, and from 40% to 30% when firing.
[*]Increase Adjudication's magazine size from 30 to 40, single hit damage from 18 to 19, and slightly reduce spread when firing.

[h2][b]STRATEGIST[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Jeff the Land Shark[/b][/h3]
Jeff's kit gets a fin-tastic rework. More frontal support and combat ability, but with less survivability.
[*]Add a new effect to Joyful Splash: Now also deals damage to enemies at 70/s and can heal allies through other allies and enemies. Damage falloff starts at 20m to a maximum of 65% at 40m; Reduce healing per second from 150 to 130.
[*]Change Aqua Burst to a charge ability (max 3 charges, 3s per charge); New effect: direct hits now launch enemies up; Increase spell field damage from 40 to 45.
[*]Change the effect of Healing Bubble from One-Time Healing to Healing Over Time. Increase Healing Amount from the previous instant 85 to 120 over 4s. Reduce max charges from 6 to 3 and remove the enemy launch-up effect.
[*]Add a new effect to Hide and Seek: It now has an energy cap (max 120) that drains by 20/s while submerged and restores 15/s when not.
[*]It's Jeff!'s (Ultimate Ability) overflow healing on swallowed allies now grants 45 Health per second as Bonus Health, up to 150.
[*]Increase the damage reduction received when taking a critical hit from 50% to 70%.
[*]Increase the energy cost of It’s Jeff (Ultimate Ability) from 4000 to 4500.

[h3][b]Luna Snow[/b][/h3]
We're giving Luna a boost to her combat prowess while slightly reducing the frequency of her Ultimate Ability.

[*]Increase Light & Dark Ice Healing Amount and Damage from 20 per round to 22.
[*]Add a new effect to Absolute Zero: Now grants 50 Bonus Health per enemy hit.
[*]Increase the energy cost of Fate of Both Worlds (Ultimate Ability) from 4500 to 5000.

[h3][b]Rocket Raccoon[/b][/h3]
Rocket Raccoon's survivability is taking a tiny hit!

Also, he's blasting off from the Ammo Overload and losing the Team-Up Anchor bonus, but he's gaining a new Team-Up Anchor bonus in the Rocket Network for some stellar new support!
[*]Reduce Repair Mode direct hit Healing Amount from 55 to 50.

[h2][b]TEAM-UP ABILITIES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]NEW:
Chilling Assault (Luna Snow- Hawkeye)[/b][/h3]
[*]As the Team-Up Anchor, Luna Snow gains a 15% increase in healing effects.
[*]Hawkeye unlocks a new Ice Arrow ability through his Team-Up with Luna Snow.

[h3][b]Jeff-nado (Storm - Jeff the Land Shark)[/b][/h3]
[*]Storm gains the Shark Surge ability through her Team-Up with Jeff the Land Shark.
[*]Jeff gains the It's Jeff-nado! ability through his Team-Up with Storm.

[h3][b]Operation: Microchip (The Punisher - Black Widow)[/b][/h3]
[*]As the Team-Up Anchor, The Punisher gains a maximum health increase of 25 and a 5% boost in damage output.
[*]Black Widow unlocks a new Pulse Rifle ability through her Team-Up with The Punisher.

[h3][b]Rocket Network (Rocket Raccoon - Peni Parker)[/b][/h3]
[*]As the Team-Up Anchor, Rocket Raccoon gains a 5% increase in healing effects. When the Team-Up is active, Rocket's B.R.B. is upgraded to a Web Beacon.
[*]Peni Parker unlocks a new Armored Spider-Nest ability through her Team-Up with Rocket Raccoon.

[h3][b]Stark Protocol (Iron Man - Ultron)[/b][/h3]
[*]As the Team-Up Anchor, Iron Man gains a 5% boost in damage output.
[*]Ultron gains a new Nano-Ray ability from his Team-Up with Iron Man.

[h3][b]Symbiote Shenanigans (Venom - Jeff the Land Shark)[/b][/h3]
[*]As the Team-Up Anchor, Venom gains a maximum health increase of 150.
[*]Jeff gains the Healing Tendrils ability through his Team-Up with Venom.

[h2][b]ADJUSTED OR REMOVED:[/b][/h2]


[h3][b]Allied Agents (Hawkeye - Black Widow)[/b][/h3]
[*]The Team-Up Anchor effect for Hawkeye has been removed, along with the Allied Agents Team-Up Ability.
[*]Black Widow loses the Supersensory Hunt ability she once had through her Team-Up with Hawkeye.

[h3][b]Ammo Overload (Rocket Raccoon - The Punisher)[/b][/h3]
[*]The Team-Up Anchor effect for Rocket Raccoon has been removed, along with the Ammo Overload Team-Up Ability.
[*]The Punisher loses the Infinite Punishment ability he once had through his Team-Up with Rocket Raccoon.

[h3][b]Chilling Charisma (Luna Snow - Jeff the Land Shark)[/b][/h3]
[*]The Team-Up Anchor effect for Luna Snow has been removed, along with the Chilling Charisma Team-Up Ability.
[*]Jeff the Land Shark loses the Frozen Spitball ability from his Team-Up with Luna Snow.

[h3][b]Gamma Charge (Hulk - Iron Man/Namor)[/b][/h3]
[*]Iron Man loses the Gamma Overdrive ability previously gained from his Team-Up with Hulk.

[h3][b]Symbiote Bond (Venom - Peni Parker/Spider-Man)[/b][/h3]
[*]The Team-Up Anchor effect for Venom has been removed, along with the Symbiote Bond Team-Up Ability.
[*]Spider-Man loses the Suit Expulsion ability previously gained from his Team-Up with Venom.
[*]Peni Parker loses the Armor Expulsion ability previously gained from her Team-Up with Venom.

[h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES:[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Atlas Bond (Iron Fist-Luna Snow)[/b][/h3]
[*]Decrease the Atlas Bond Team-Up Anchor damage boost proportion from 15% to 10%.

[h3][b]Fantastic Four (Invisible Woman - Human Torch - Mister Fantastic - The Thing)[/b][/h3]
We're slightly reducing the usage coverage of this Team-Up.
[*]Increase cooldown of Storm Siblings, Wedded Harmony, and Cooperative Comrades from 20s to 25s.

[h3][b]Gamma Charge (Hulk - Namor)[/b][/h3]
A minor reduction to the usage coverage of this Team-Up.
[*]Increase Gamma Monstro cooldown from 15s to 20s.

[h3][b]Mental Projection (Emma Frost - Psylocke/Magneto)[/b][/h3]
We've reduced the damage capability of this Team-Up.
[*]Reduce the proportion of damage caused by Magnetic Resonance and Soul Resurgence illusions from 30% to 20%.
